channel.title: Deeside fuel prices
channel.description: Price moves and the cheapest fuel around Deeside, from the GOV.UK Fuel Finder scheme via the Deeside.com fuel map.

item.title: Hillcrest Motor Co Ltd cuts diesel by 3.0p to 195.9p
item.description: Hillcrest Motor Co Ltd has cut its diesel price from 198.9p to 195.9p a litre, a fall of 3.0p. It is 8.8 miles from Queensferry.

item.title: Deeside fuel prices today, 9 November
item.description: Unleaded: Deeside average 170.3p across 50 stations, UK average 169.7p (above by 0.6p); down 3.2p on last week. Diesel: Deeside average 210.8p across 50 stations, UK average 204.6p (above by 6.2p); down 0.7p on last week.

item.title: Sainsburys Ellesmere Port cuts diesel by 5.0p to 192.9p
item.description: Sainsburys Ellesmere Port has cut its diesel price from 197.9p to 192.9p a litre, a fall of 5.0p. It is 8.1 miles from Queensferry.

item.title: Deeside fuel prices today, 8 November
item.description: Unleaded: Deeside average 170.3p across 50 stations, UK average 169.8p (above by 0.5p); down 3.2p on last week. Diesel: Deeside average 210.9p across 50 stations, UK average 204.6p (above by 6.3p); down 0.6p on last week.
